svg.aria-label: How podbag compares with Docker, Podman and Kiri on one Linux VM: a container starts in 4.1 ms (Docker 73.8 ms); 100 containers hold 105 MiB (Docker 562 MiB); nothing runs with no containers (Docker 203 MiB); 8 Spring services in 2 releases take 902 MiB of disk (Docker 2,970 MiB) and 324 MiB of page cache (Docker 982 MiB).
